snippet.title: Manifest Anything Gameplay Demo Directed by E
snippet.description:
Manifest Anything is an AI-powered game creation experience built with Unreal Engine 5, where players can design and play games using natural language and voice interaction.

In this gameplay demo, you’ll see how players can:

Describe a game idea in real time

Use voice commands to modify the world, gameplay, and rules

Instantly explore and play inside the generated experience

Experiment freely in a creative sandbox environment

Manifest Anything removes traditional barriers to game development by letting ideas become playable experiences—no coding required. Every session is interactive, dynamic, and driven by player intent.

This demo showcases early gameplay and core systems currently in development.

🎮 Coming Soon on Steam
🌐 Website: https://www.manifestanything.ai
